knowledge_metrics.linked: Linked into a topic within 24 hours

knowledge_metrics.clear_failed: On-device statistics could not be fully cleared. Your Vault and settings are untouched; please try again.
knowledge_metrics.clear_hint: Only removes on-device aggregates. Your Vault, notes, version history, settings, and models stay untouched.

status.cleared: Statistics are cleared; a fresh cycle starts the next time recording is allowed.
status.vault_unavailable: Open a Vault to see its aggregate summary.
status.keychain_unavailable: The system keychain is unavailable, so no new statistics are being recorded.
status.key_missing: Old statistics remain but can no longer be read safely. Clear them before starting again.
status.invalid_key: Protection for on-device statistics is invalid, so recording has stopped.
status.database_unavailable: On-device statistics are unavailable, so no new data is being recorded.

assignment.default_llm_desc: Sets the model used for conversation, translation and text generation.
assignment.realtime_llm_desc: Used for all translation (popup, notes, live captions); when unset, prefers an installed dedicated translation model, otherwise inherits the default chat model.
assignment.realtime_asr_desc: Used for speech recognition while recording; it must be assigned a model with confirmed transcription capability.
assignment.batch_asr_desc: Used for imported media and the full transcript after recording; inherits the real-time model when unset.
assignment.default_embedding_desc: Sets the model used for knowledge indexing and semantic retrieval.

storage.vault_root_desc: Open the selected vault without moving files from the original location.
storage.models_root_desc: Root folder of Lunarca-managed models; changed only through “Move to…” on the AI engine / models page, which copies and verifies before switching.

voice_input.auto_refine_desc: Removes fillers and adds punctuation; turning it off preserves the original transcript.
voice_input.translate_enabled_desc: Output the translation while previewing the original.
voice_input.translate_target_lang_desc: Sets the target language used when translated output is enabled.
voice_input.landing_mode_desc: Type into the current app, copy to the clipboard, or save as a quick note.
voice_input.input_mode_desc: Hold the shortcut while speaking, or press once to start and again to stop.
voice_input.lang_hint_desc: Specifies the spoken language for better accuracy; use automatic detection for multilingual input.
voice_input.quick_note_refine_desc: Adds a title, tasks and dates to quick notes; preserves the original when the model is unavailable or the text has been edited.
voice_input.keep_audio_desc: Save quick-note audio as an attachment for playback or retranscription.

popup_translate.native_lang_desc: Translate your native language to the default foreign language, and other languages back to your native language.
popup_translate.default_foreign_desc: Sets the foreign language paired with your native language for smart bidirectional translation.
popup_translate.default_preset_desc: The tone template popup translation opens with.
popup_translate.auto_copy_desc: Replace clipboard contents when translation finishes.

build_info.title: Build identity
build_info.description: Use these exact values when reporting a desktop build or checking server compatibility.

advanced_target: “{{item}}” is an advanced setting under “{{page}}”. Turn on “Show full settings” to view and edit it.
advanced_mode_desc: Shows technical and maintenance options; existing values stay unchanged.

notifications.completed_enabled_desc: Shows alerts when long tasks finish; notification history retains these records when disabled.
notifications.system_enabled_desc: Send system notifications while in the background. System permission is required.
notifications.suppress_while_recording_desc: Defer regular notifications until recording ends. Critical alerts still appear.

appearance.theme_desc: Sets a light or dark interface, or follows the system setting.
appearance.language_desc: Language of the interface; applies immediately.
appearance.reduce_motion_desc: Softens interface animation; also honoured when the system setting is on.
appearance.high_contrast_desc: Raises text-to-background contrast for bright environments.
appearance.density_desc: Adjusts spacing to show more content or provide more room for reading.
appearance.launch_overview_desc: Show tasks and unfinished setup at launch.

theme_library.title: Color theme
theme_library.hint: Choose which color theme to use. Preview, install from a file or uninstall themes under Apps › Themes. Light and dark follow Appearance mode above.
theme_library.update_meta: {{author}} · {{license}} · Update to {{version}} available in Apps › Themes

shortcuts.mode_double_hint: Fires only when the same combination is pressed twice quickly; a single press is left alone
shortcuts.recording_tip: Press the new combination; Esc cancels, Delete clears
shortcuts.double_tap_locked: System editing keys such as ⌘C can only be double-tapped, otherwise they would take over copy and paste
shortcuts.popup_translate_desc: Translates selected text, or opens an input box when nothing is selected.
shortcuts.screenshot_translate_desc: Select an area of the screen, then read and translate the text in it.
shortcuts.desktop_lens_desc: Starts or stops a Translate Space session (Labs feature).
shortcuts.desktop_lens_capture_desc: Captures the current frame during a session; inert when no session is running.
shortcuts.double_tap_window_ms_desc: How close two presses must be to count as a double tap. Shared by every shortcut set to double-tap: longer is more forgiving, shorter is more responsive.
shortcuts.voice_input_desc: Starts voice input; releasing the shortcut ends dictation in hold-to-talk mode.
shortcuts.text_quick_note_desc: Open the capture panel from any app; press Enter to save straight into your vault.
shortcuts.quick_chat_desc: Calls up the quick chat panel from anywhere.
shortcuts.toggle_sidebar_desc: Collapse or expand the list sidebar (in-app shortcut).
shortcuts.reopen_closed_tab_desc: Reopen recently closed tabs, most recent first (in-app shortcut).
shortcuts.toggle_reading_view_desc: Switch between editing and reading (in-app shortcut, for the current note).
shortcuts.ai_composer_desc: Open or close the AI actions panel in a note (in-app shortcut).
shortcuts.recording_toggle_desc: Starts or pauses recording using the shortcut.
shortcuts.recording_bookmark_desc: Marks the current moment so playback can jump straight to it. While the teleprompter is following you, it marks the line you are reading as a retake instead. Unbound by default.
shortcuts.teleprompter_toggle_desc: Instantly hides the teleprompter if it shows up in a recording; press again to bring it back. Only active when the Teleprompter app is installed.
shortcuts.teleprompter_send_desc: Sends the selected text to the teleprompter; when no selection can be read (as in Google Docs), sends the clipboard text instead. Only active when the Teleprompter app is installed.
shortcuts.teleprompter_play_desc: While the teleprompter is shown: start or pause auto-scroll.
shortcuts.teleprompter_line_up_desc: While shown: move the reading line up one line; follow-along continues from there.
shortcuts.teleprompter_line_down_desc: While shown: move the reading line down one line; follow-along continues from there.
shortcuts.teleprompter_block_prev_desc: While shown: back to the start of this section, or the previous one if already there.
shortcuts.teleprompter_block_next_desc: While shown: jump to the start of the next section.
shortcuts.teleprompter_faster_desc: While shown: speed up auto-scroll one step.
shortcuts.teleprompter_slower_desc: While shown: slow down auto-scroll one step.
shortcuts.teleprompter_current: Teleprompter: Back to where you are
shortcuts.teleprompter_current_desc: During follow-along: bring the line you're reading back to the reading line.
shortcuts.teleprompter_top_desc: While shown: back to the start of the script.
shortcuts.teleprompter_close_desc: While shown: close the teleprompter and stop follow-along.
shortcuts.live_caption_desc: Shows or hides the floating caption panel.
shortcuts.diagnostic_unavailable: The system refused this combination (most likely another app owns it). Pick another one.
shortcuts.diagnostic_invalid: This binding could not be registered — record it again.
shortcuts.diagnostic_reserved_system: This is a common system combination; the system may answer it first.
shortcuts.diagnostic_tap_failed: Keystroke observation failed to start, so double-tap can't trigger for now. If a restart doesn't help, please report it.
shortcuts.diagnostic_double_tap_unsupported: Double-tap isn't supported on this system yet — use a single-press combination.
shortcuts.unsupported_key: That key can't be recorded — try another combination.

vault.templates_dir_desc: Where note templates live (path relative to the Vault).
vault.delete_mode_desc: Send deleted notes to the system trash, the in-Vault trash, or remove them permanently.
vault.trash_retention_days_desc: Permanently delete after the retention period. Items can be restored before then.
vault.snapshot_max_versions_desc: How many past versions to keep per note; the oldest is pruned beyond this.
vault.show_hidden_files_desc: List files starting with “.” in the file tree; they stay out of search, the graph and links. Lunarca’s own data and .git are never listed.
vault.ai_artifacts_dir_desc: Where AI summaries, translations, and similar results are filed.
vault.notes_dir_desc: Default location for newly created notes.
vault.quick_notes_dir_desc: Where voice input lands when you choose “save as quick note”.
vault.recordings_dir_desc: Where recording notes and their audio files are stored.
vault.transcripts_dir_desc: Where transcripts of imported media are filed.
vault.documents_dir_desc: Where notes converted from imported documents (Word, text, spreadsheets…) and their original files are filed.
vault.chats_dir_desc: Where AI chats saved to history are stored.
vault.creator_dir_desc: Where video project folders and swipe entries are stored.
vault.teleprompter_dir_desc: Where “New script” and “New from clipboard” save scripts.
vault.translate_space_dir_desc: Source and translated text you confirm in Translate Space is written here.
vault.knowledge_dir_desc: Used for new topic pages and knowledge maps only. Existing pages are not moved.
vault.attachment_location_desc: Whether pasted images and files go to the Vault root, next to the note, a subfolder next to the note, or one specific folder.
vault.attachment_folder_desc: Sets the note-adjacent subfolder name or a specified vault-relative path.
vault.graph_ai_tags_desc: Extracts relationship tags after saving or transcription, preserving manual tags and respecting folder generation settings.
vault.delete_mode_desc_trash: Move deleted files to system Trash. Restore them using the system.
vault.delete_mode_desc_vault_trash: Move deleted files to vault trash. They are permanently deleted after the retention period.

editor.preview_tabs_desc: A single click opens a note as a preview tab (italic) that is kept once you double-click or edit. When off, opening a note always replaces the current tab.
editor.autosave_enabled_desc: Saves edited content after typing stops.
editor.autosave_debounce_ms_desc: How long to wait after the last keystroke; longer means fewer disk writes.
editor.localize_remote_images_desc: Downloads pasted remote images as vault attachments for offline access; strict local mode prevents downloads.
editor.typewriter_mode_desc: Keeps the current line centered while editing.
editor.focus_mode_desc: Dims everything outside the current paragraph.
editor.spellcheck_desc: Underline misspelled words in Latin-script languages in your notes; right-click for corrections. Code, links and Chinese, Japanese and Korean aren’t checked.
editor.body_width_desc: Maximum line width of note text, shared by editing, reading, and the knowledge reader.
editor.show_format_toolbar_desc: Shows formatting controls below the editor title.
editor.floating_summary_lang_desc: Language used by the floating AI menu when it summarises a note.
editor.floating_context_desc: Include the surrounding paragraph on each side. This context is also uploaded when running on a server. Only the selection is edited.
editor.floating_summary_style_desc: Whether AI summaries in notes default to key points, a paragraph, or one sentence; the Summarize submenu can override per run.

labs.translate_space_enabled_desc: Shows Translate Space and enables its shortcuts; turning it off ends the session and unregisters the shortcuts.

action.reset_hint: Restore this setting to its default
action.reset_preview_failed: Unable to read the changes. Close and try again.
action.reset_effects: Defaults may change network access, audio saving, or deletion behavior. Resetting settings does not delete existing files.

route_strategy.local_first: Local first (stop if it can't run here)
route_strategy.local_only: Local only (never sent to a server)

models.title: Model library

relocate.hint: Files are verified before switching. The original location remains active until completion.
relocate.confirm: From {{from}} to {{to}}: {{bytes}} in total, {{available}} free on the target volume. Models cannot be installed while moving; the old folder stays valid until the switch.
relocate.done: Moved to {{path}}; the old folder was removed.
relocate.done_old_kept: Moved to {{path}} and switched, but the old folder could not be removed. You can delete it by hand.
relocate.failed: Move failed: {{reason}} The old folder is untouched.
relocate.cancelled: Cancelled; the old folder is untouched.

reason.same_dir: The target is the current folder.
reason.nested: The target and the current folder contain each other.
reason.not_dir: The target is not a folder.
reason.not_empty: The target folder is not empty; pick an empty one.
reason.not_writable: The target folder is not writable.
reason.not_absolute: The target must be an absolute path.
reason.insufficient_disk: Not enough space on the target volume (needs the models' total size plus a 512 MiB reserve).
reason.install_in_progress: A model is downloading; wait for it to finish or pause it first.
reason.already_running: A move is already in progress.
reason.source_unreadable: The current model folder cannot be read.

models.assignment_intro: Automatic selection follows server policy and device capabilities.
models.local_intro_primary: Install and manage local models here.
models.local_intro_fallback: Local fallback varies by capability. See AI Services.

slot_desc.realtime_llm: Used for all translation (popup, notes, low-latency live captions); when unset, prefers an installed dedicated translation model, otherwise inherits the default chat model.

slot_desc.batch_asr: Used for imported media and the full transcript after recording; inherits the real-time model when unset.
slot_desc.default_embedding: Used for knowledge indexing, retrieval, and similar-content checks.

service.in_process: Runs in process with no network endpoint

plan.permanent: Model files will be permanently deleted without using the system trash.

reason.MODEL_DISK_SPACE_INSUFFICIENT: The target volume does not have enough free space.
reason.MODEL_INSTALL_UNAVAILABLE: No installation source is currently available.

plan.update_note: The new version replaces the installed one only after it downloads and passes verification; if the update fails, the old version keeps working.
plan.reindex_note: This is an embedding model: new weights mean the library index has to be rebuilt once, and search may be incomplete meanwhile.

local_engine.refused_unknown: {{name}}: could not estimate the memory it needs, so it was not loaded to be safe

local_engine.import_hint: Choose a local GGUF model file; what it was recognized as is shown after import.

hf_import.hint: Enter a model repository, such as owner/name.
hf_import.empty: This repository has no usable GGUF files.

models.download_source_desc: Which host to try first when downloading local models. If it can't be reached, the other one is tried automatically; in mainland China, ModelScope is usually faster.

recording.input_device_desc: System Default follows the microphone selected in system settings.
recording.capture_source_desc: When capturing both, microphone and system audio are saved as separate tracks.
recording.separate_translation_desc: Shows recording translations in a separate movable window.
recording.vad_sensitivity_desc: Higher sensitivity misses less speech but may detect noise as speech. Applies to the next audio session.
recording.vad_engine_desc: Uses energy detection if Silero is unavailable. Applies to the next audio session.
recording.disk_warn_gib_desc: Warns when free space drops below the threshold and stops recording if space falls further to preserve recorded content.
recording.rolling_split_gib_desc: Rolls over to a new file once the current one reaches this size, which keeps long recordings safe.
recording.waveform_fps_desc: How often the recording waveform redraws; lower uses less power.
recording.distill_mode_desc: After a recording is transcribed, turn it into a knowledge note in your vault.

realtime.transcribe_enabled_desc: Show transcription while recording. Transcription still runs after recording if this is off.
realtime.translate_enabled_desc: Translates the live transcript as it appears.
realtime.transcribe_lang_desc: Sets the recognition language for recording and live captions; automatic detection supports multilingual sessions.
realtime.translate_target_lang_desc: The foreign language paired with your native one: native speech goes to it, anything else comes back.

transcribe.lang_desc: Spoken language for imported media; independent of the live recording setting.
transcribe.diarize_auto_desc: Identifies speakers after transcription; skips this step when the required model is missing.
transcribe.fetch_media_desc: Sets whether link imports retain audio or video by default; each import can override this choice.
transcribe.fetch_tool_path_desc: Leave empty to search automatically (Homebrew / pipx / MacPorts / PATH). Point at the executable if it lives elsewhere.
transcribe.fetch_proxy_desc: Proxy used when downloading online videos, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080. Leave empty for no proxy.
transcribe.distill_mode_desc: After a media transcript finishes, turn it into a knowledge note in your vault.

caption.capture_source_desc: Sets whether live captions use the microphone, system audio or both, taking effect in the next session.
caption.translation_enabled_desc: Shows the translation under each caption line.
caption.font_size_desc: Text size of the floating captions.
caption.max_lines_desc: Limits the lines shown in the caption window and scrolls automatically when the limit is exceeded.
caption.text_opacity_desc: Text background opacity. 0 removes the background.
caption.frame_opacity_desc: Caption panel background. At 0, transparent mode shows only the latest line.
caption.text_color_desc: Sets the caption text color in immersive or transparent mode.
caption.separate_translation_desc: Shows translations in a separate movable window while the original window shows source text only.
caption.show_source_desc: Turn off to see only the translation (film-subtitle style for foreign videos). The Original / Bilingual / Translation switch on the caption overlay is the same value.
caption.translation_first_desc: When bilingual, show the translation on top and the original smaller below, like bilingual film subtitles.

glossary.title: Personal Dictionary
glossary.empty: Add preferred spellings for names and terms. Results depend on the model.
glossary.scope: Used to correct recognition and translated terms in voice input, transcription, captions and translation. Results depend on the model.
glossary.importHint: TXT / CSV / TSV. One original,preferred pair or one term per line.

placeholder.canonical: e.g. Lunarca, Kubernetes, To Be Determined

quickAdd.title: Add to glossary
quickAdd.desc: Used to guide recognition and transcription corrections. Results depend on the model.

degradation.green_max_rtf_desc: Live transcription staying under this share of real time counts as smooth. Rarely needs changing.
degradation.yellow_max_rtf_desc: Above the smooth tier but under this, window density is reduced to protect responsiveness.
degradation.orange_max_rtf_desc: Above this threshold, transcription runs after recording ends.

diarize.cluster_threshold_desc: Sets the voice similarity threshold; lower values split one speaker more easily, while higher values merge different speakers more easily.

chat.capture_selection_desc: Includes text selected in another app when opening a conversation; the reference can be removed before sending.
chat.save_history_desc: Saves new conversations to the vault by default; turning it off makes them temporary while allowing individual saves.
chat.grounding_desc: Searches notes and cites sources by default in new conversations; can be disabled for each conversation.
chat.distill_mode_desc: After a chat ends (when you start a new one), turn it into a knowledge note in your vault.

speech.highlight_desc: Highlights the current sentence and scrolls along during reading.

playback.video_layout_desc: How the picture and the transcript are arranged during playback.
playback.video_subtitles_desc: Shows the current subtitle at the bottom of the video, following the source, translation or bilingual playback setting.
playback.subtitle_size_desc: Size of the subtitles drawn over the picture.
playback.background_video_desc: Keeps audio only or shows a floating video when leaving playback; audio continues in both modes.

error.option: Not one of the allowed values — not saved.
error.range: Outside the allowed range ({{min}}–{{max}}) — not saved.
error.duplicate_option: The same item cannot appear twice — not saved.
error.required_category: Keep at least one writing entry and one material entry — not saved.
error.decimal: Enter a number inside the allowed range.
error.path: Only paths inside the Vault are accepted (no absolute paths or “..”).
error.filename_template: Invalid naming template: only {name}, {date}, {time}, {format} and {content} are allowed, braces must be balanced, the characters / \ : * ? " < > | are not allowed, and it cannot be empty.
error.shortcut: That combination cannot be a shortcut: use at least one modifier (⌘/⇧/⌥) plus a key.
error.shortcut_reserved: Editing keys such as ⌘C only work as double taps, otherwise they hijack system copy and paste.
error.shortcut_editor: This is one of the editor's own shortcuts (such as ⌘B for bold or ⌘F for find); binding it here would trigger both at once.
error.shortcut_key: That key can't be recorded — try another combination.
error.shortcut_conflict: {{attempted}} is already used by “{{detail}}” — pick another combination.
error.persist: Couldn't save: writing the settings file failed. Check disk space and file permissions. ({{detail}})
error.reset_stale: Settings or the current vault changed. Review the reset plan again.
error.text_too_long: That is too long. Shorten it a little and try again.

tools.title: Import from link components
tools.managed_scope: Lunarca only manages the copies it installs itself and never modifies versions installed via Homebrew or other package managers.
tools.ffmpeg_why_manual: FFmpeg publishes no official binaries or checksums, so Lunarca doesn't download it for you. Install it yourself as shown below.
tools.models_elsewhere: Models are downloaded and removed under Local models.
tools.js_runtime_desc: Used for media downloads from YouTube and other sites.
tools.js_runtime_why_manual: Lunarca can install Deno for you, or you can install any one of Deno, Node or Bun yourself; Lunarca picks Deno → Node → Bun in that order.
tools.update_hint: Does not update automatically. Check the tool version if downloads fail.
tools.after_install: After installation, select Recheck. No restart needed.
tools.js_runtime_install_failed: yt-dlp installed fine, but the JavaScript runtime could not be installed: {{reason}} Retry later, or install one yourself using the instructions below.
tools.ffmpeg_missing: Without ffmpeg, video quality is usually limited to about 720p.
tools.js_runtime_missing: Without a runtime, sites may reject downloads.

excluded_paths.label: Excluded paths
excluded_paths.hint: Excluded items stay out of search and automatic suggestions. Right-click a folder or note in the file tree to exclude it.
excluded_paths.scope: Excluded folders and notes stay out of search, the quick switcher, the graph, the semantic index and knowledge-base suggestions, and their attachments are never listed as unreferenced. Links are still maintained: renaming a note updates links inside them too.

orphan_assets.label: Unreferenced attachments
orphan_assets.hint: Find attachments not referenced by notes, then choose which to remove.
orphan_assets.scope: Files referenced by notes in the trash or by earlier versions are not counted, so restoring them never breaks an image or link.
orphan_assets.kept: {{n}} became referenced after the list was made and were kept.

vault_index.label: Note index
vault_index.hint: Update the list and search index without changing notes.
vault_index.done: Index up to date, {{count}} notes processed this time
vault_index.cancelled: Cancelled. What was already processed is kept; the next time the vault opens it picks up from there.

semantic.label: Semantic index
semantic.allFresh: Every note's semantic index is up to date.
semantic.standardPending: Search is available. {{count}} notes still need indexing.
semantic.emptyNotes: {{count}} more notes have nothing to embed (empty or title-only) and are skipped.
semantic.disabledHint: Semantic search is off. Keyword search is still available.
semantic.missingWhy: Semantic search needs a local embedding model. Download it in one click on the Local models page; it runs on this device with nothing else to install.

blocked.no_model_hint: Pick a ready model for "Default embedding model" under AI services › Model assignment.
blocked.unsupported_model_hint: Semantic indexing only accepts reviewed embedding profiles; choose a supported model in model assignment.
blocked.profile_unverified: "{{model}}" has not passed its benchmark yet
blocked.profile_unverified_hint: Retrieval quality and chunking for this model are not verified on-device yet, so it cannot serve the production index; switch to a verified model for now.
blocked.server_unavailable: Server embedding is unavailable right now
blocked.server_unavailable_hint: Make sure you are signed in and the server is reachable, then choose Check again.

trust.title: Server identity
trust.deployment_id: Deployment ID: {{id}} (for reference only; not part of the identity check)
trust.offered_label: Public keys this server currently reports

provenance.password: verified when you signed in with your password
provenance.rotated: updated automatically after the server rotated its keys

trust.unpinned: This server identity has not been verified yet. It is checked and recorded when you sign in.
trust.official: This is Lunarca Cloud: its identity is vouched for by trust built into the app, so there is nothing for you to check.
trust.bypassed: LUNARCA_LEASE_PUBKEY / LUNARCA_CATALOG_PUBKEY are set in the environment, so signature checks use them and identity verification is skipped entirely. This is a development setting; do not set these variables in production.
trust.changed_title: This server’s signing keys have changed. The connection is paused.
trust.changed_body: The keys it reports differ from the ones verified earlier. Your administrator may have rotated the keys legitimately, or something may be impersonating the server. Until you confirm, Lunarca keeps using the previously verified keys.
trust.repin_consequences: Confirming treats this as a server with a new identity: its catalog cache and rollback protection are reset and its sign-in credentials are cleared, so you will sign in again. After a legitimate redeployment these need to start over anyway.
trust.confirm_change: I have checked the new keys — confirm the change
trust.import_hint: Use this when your administrator sent an organization config file (.json): it verifies and pins the server identity, and the sign-in form picks that server.
trust.import_needs_confirmation: The keys in this file differ from the ones verified earlier. Nothing has been changed yet — review above and confirm.
trust.tls_root_pinned: The root certificate from the file is now trusted for this server only; nothing needs to be installed in the system trust store.
trust.tls_root_absent: This file contains no root certificate. If the server uses a self-signed certificate, use the connection link from your administrator instead.
trust.tls_root_invalid: The root certificate in the file could not be read and was not enabled. Ask your administrator to export the config file again.

import_error.TRUST_FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read. Check the path and permissions.
import_error.TRUST_FILE_MALFORMED: The file is incomplete or not valid JSON. Ask your administrator for a new one.
import_error.TRUST_FILE_NOT_ORG_CONFIG: This is not a Lunarca organization configuration file. Check that you selected the right file.
import_error.TRUST_FILE_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: This configuration file uses a newer format than this version supports. Update Lunarca first.
import_error.TRUST_FILE_BAD_SERVER_URL: The server address in the file is invalid (expected https://host:port). Check with your administrator.
import_error.TRUST_FILE_BAD_PUBKEY: A signing key in the file is invalid. Ask your administrator for a new file.
import_error.TRUST_CREDENTIAL_CLEAR_FAILED: Clearing the previous sign-in credentials failed. Unlock the system keychain and try again.
import_error.TRUST_CLOUD_UNAVAILABLE: This build does not include the cloud client.

probe_error.network: The server’s public keys could not be fetched last time: unreachable.
probe_error.server_error: The server’s public keys could not be fetched last time: it does not provide a key endpoint (older server version, or blocked by a reverse proxy).
probe_error.invalid_endpoint: The public keys could not be fetched last time: the server address is invalid.
probe_error.malformed: The keys fetched last time could not be parsed. Make sure the client and server versions match.
probe_error.unsupported_format: This server’s identity format is newer than this version supports. Update Lunarca first.
probe_error.rate_limited: Too many requests. Test the connection again a little later.
probe_error.strict_local: Strict local mode does not fetch public keys.
probe_error.unknown: The server’s public keys could not be fetched last time.

knowledge.ingest_mode_desc: Prepare additions for related topics. Evidence pages require confirmation; legacy topics receive additions automatically.
knowledge.semantic_desc: Adds semantic matching to keyword search; uses keyword search when a local embedding model is missing.
knowledge.checkup_reminder_desc: Remind you to review the knowledge base every two weeks. Does not run AI automatically.

workspace.quick_start_actions_desc: Sets the Add Content order and quick-start entries, retaining at least one writing and one import entry without changing capabilities or permissions.
workspace.rail_layout_desc: Sets space order and visibility; Notes and Knowledge remain visible, and hidden spaces remain accessible through shortcuts, commands and deep links.
creator.board_stages_desc: Which stages the board shows and in what order; keep at least one. Projects in a hidden column appear in the column before it.
creator.board_view_desc: Board shows a column per stage, List groups projects by stage, Table shows one project per row, Calendar lays projects out by planned publish date.
creator.channel_voice_desc: A sentence or two about your channel and how you talk (for example, “for programmers, direct, lots of analogies”). It goes to the AI as guidance when generating chapters, packages, rewrites and script edits; leave it empty to skip. Stored in this library, so it follows you across devices.
orderedToggleList.locked: “{{label}}” is an anchor and is always shown
privacy.local_workspace_metrics_desc: Aggregated on this device. No content, paths or identity are recorded or uploaded.

workspace_metrics.title: Local workspace usage
workspace_metrics.window: {{start}} to {{end}} (kept for the last {{retention}} days on this device)
workspace_metrics.disabled: Workspace statistics are off on this device.
workspace_metrics.tooFewSamples: fewer than {{count}} samples — no percentage yet
workspace_metrics.clear_desc: The visit and creation roll-ups kept on this device will be deleted. This cannot be undone. It is separate from “Local knowledge improvements” — that data is untouched.
workspace_metrics.cleared: This device's workspace records were cleared.

unavailable.storageUnavailable: This device cannot write or read these records right now. Nothing already recorded has been deleted — try again in a moment.
unavailable.schemaInvalid: These records were written by an older or newer version and we do not recognise their structure, so we neither read them, change them, nor migrate them for you. To keep recording you have to clear them and start over — what follows a clear is a new observation period, and numbers from before and after it cannot be compared side by side.

settings_io.label: Settings backup & restore
settings_io.hint: Backs up settings for the same version. Excludes credentials.
settings_io.scope: Exports a TOML file for a same-version backup or to carry to another machine. Secrets are never exported; model assignments and internal state are left out too. Import accepts only a Lunarca export of the same version.
settings_io.preview_summary: {{count}} settings will change; {{unchanged}} are unchanged. Apply after confirmation.
settings_io.preview_none: Every setting in the file already matches; there's nothing to import.
settings_io.plan_changed: The file or your current settings just changed, so nothing was written. Choose the file again to review the changes.
settings_io.include_vault: Include settings for the current vault
settings_io.imported: Imported {{device}} device settings and {{vault}} vault settings
settings_io.rejected: This file did not pass validation (different version, unknown keys or invalid values). Existing settings are unchanged.

footprint.label: Data footprint
footprint.hint: View local data locations and storage use. The vault is listed here but cannot be deleted here.
footprint.uninstall_hint: Model files and keychain credentials remain after removing the app. Clear them here if you want to remove them.

entry.vault_desc: Notes, recordings and attachments are shown here for reference and cannot be deleted from this panel.
entry.vault_cache_desc: Derived index and caches inside the vault's .luna folder, rebuildable at any time. Version snapshots, sidecars and vault settings are not included.
entry.vault_trash_desc: Notes deleted from within the app. Emptying is permanent.
entry.models_desc: whisper / VAD / diarization weights and CoreML artifacts. Clearing all first releases their assignments; bundled models stay.
entry.app_config_desc: Settings file, known-vault list and catalog cache. Reset backs it up before restoring defaults.
entry.device_records_desc: Usage and notification history, knowledge and workspace improvement records, each cleared from its own panel.

confirm.vault_cache_title: Clear the vault cache and rebuild the index?
confirm.vault_cache: Only the derived index and caches are removed, then the vault is rescanned. Notes, snapshots and vault settings are untouched.
confirm.vault_trash: Notes and attachments in the trash are deleted permanently.
confirm.models: Downloaded models and their CoreML assets will be permanently deleted. Bundled models are kept. Assigned slots return to device policy; these models must be downloaded again when needed.
confirm.reset: All device settings return to defaults (the old configuration is backed up next to it), and the app cache and startup diagnostics are cleared. Vault, models, credentials and local records are untouched. The app restarts afterwards.

reset_blocked.restart_blocked_capture: A recording, live captions, or voice input is still running, so nothing was reset. Try again when it’s finished.
reset_blocked.restart_save_failed: A note couldn’t be saved (a write failed or it conflicts with an outside change), so nothing was reset. Your text is still in the editor. Sort it out and try again.
reset_blocked.restart_save_timeout: Saving your notes took too long, so nothing was reset. Your text is still in the editor. Try again in a moment.

impact.vault_cache: Rebuilds the index after clearing. Notes are kept.
impact.vault_trash: Permanently deletes items. Cannot be undone.
impact.models: Deletes downloaded models. Bundled models are kept.

export.utf8_bom_desc: Adds a BOM to exported SRT and VTT files for older players that require it.
export.filename_template_desc: Use {name}, {date}, {time}, {format} and {content}; duplicates get a number and existing files are never overwritten.

group_aliases.glossary: dictionary terms names abbreviations corrections glossary
group_aliases.privacy: privacy storage disk space data footprint offline
group_aliases.ai_services: compute execution cloud organization server connection
group_aliases.local_models: models engine download install local model
group_aliases.voice_input: voice dictation speech read aloud tts
group_aliases.appearance: appearance theme color font accessibility interface

self_check.hint: Runs a minimal task to verify the current AI service.

sync.recordings_mode_desc: How recordings made on other devices reach this one. Notes and transcripts always sync.
sync.recordings_mode_aliases: recording audio on demand cloud only download storage
sync.pause_large_on_metered: Pause large files on metered networks
sync.pause_large_on_metered_desc: On a phone hotspot or other metered network, recordings and other large files wait; notes keep syncing.
sync.pause_large_on_battery: Pause large files on low battery
sync.pause_large_on_battery_desc: In Low Power Mode (Battery saver on Windows) or below 20% battery, recordings and other large files wait; notes keep syncing.

update.policy_desc: “Check at launch” contacts lunarca.app once after each launch to see whether a new version exists; “Manual only” goes online only when you click “Check for updates”. Never checks while Strict local is on.

app_release.title: About & updates
app_release.description: Your current version, and new versions from the official site. Updates are verified against the publisher’s signature and are never installed if verification fails.
app_release.ask_title: Check for updates automatically at launch?
app_release.ask_body: If you turn this on, Lunarca contacts lunarca.app once after each launch to see whether a new version exists and lets you know; installing is always your call. Only the version list is fetched — none of your data is sent. Otherwise Lunarca goes online only when you click “Check for updates”. You can change this any time under “App updates” below.
app_release.installing: Downloading and installing. Lunarca will restart when it’s done…

error.strict_local_blocked: Strict local is on, so Lunarca won’t go online to check for updates.
error.update_unavailable: This build isn’t connected to the update channel.
error.update_check_failed: Couldn’t reach the update server. Try again later.
error.update_install_failed: The download or signature check failed, so nothing was installed. Your current version keeps working.
error.restart_blocked_capture: A recording, live captions, or voice input is still running, so nothing was installed. Try again when it’s finished.
error.restart_save_failed: A note couldn’t be saved (a write failed or it conflicts with an outside change), so nothing was installed. Your text is still in the editor. Sort it out and try again.
error.restart_save_timeout: Saving your notes took too long, so nothing was installed. Your text is still in the editor. Try again in a moment.
error.unknown: Checking for updates didn’t finish. Try again later.
